user.title: Sign in to Nortec Go
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Nortec Go app.

data_description.email: The email address of your Nortec Go account.
data_description.password: Your Nortec Go password. It is used once to sign in and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Nortec Go again
reauth_confirm.description: The Nortec Go session for {email} was rejected. Enter your password to sign in again.

data_description.password: Your Nortec Go password. It is used once to sign in and is not stored.

error.invalid_auth: The email or password is wrong.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Nortec Go service. Check your connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a while before you try again.
error.multiple_chargers: This account has more than one charger. Only one charger per account is supported.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This charger is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This charger is already being set up or signed in again.
abort.wrong_account: This account's charger isn't the one this integration was set up for. Sign in with the same account.
